Climate_Rationale: Globalisation and trade (primary drivers) dominate IAS introduction rates; climate warming facilitates establishment of introduced species and expands their potential range – low-medium dependency.

Units_Measure: Cumulative count of all established alien species (invasive + non-invasive)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). GBIF; GRIIS; Seebens et al.
Climate_Rationale: Total alien species counts driven primarily by trade and travel volume; climate warming assists establishment but is not the primary driver of introduction events.

Indicator_Name: Forest-specialist bird species per grid cell (cSAR)
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Land Use & Agriculture | Energy
Units_Measure: Mean forest-specialist bird species richness per grid cell (cSAR model)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). cSAR – forest specialists. Martins & Pereira.
Climate_Rationale: cSAR uses forest cover inputs; climate embedded in range maps via SDMs; forest loss driven by both land use and climate-induced fires.

Units_Measure: Functional intactness index from Madingley general ecosystem model
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Harfoot et al. 2014; Madingley model.
Climate_Rationale: Madingley general ecosystem model is driven by NPP and temperature; climate change affects modelled food web structure and biomass distribution through primary productivity inputs.

Indicator_Name: Global mammal and bird species remaining
Units_Measure: % of pre-human mammal and bird species still extant globally
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: GBF Goal A (halt extinction). Highlighted indicator in IPBES GA. SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss and prevent extinction). Informs CBD extinction rate tracking.
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Highlighted indicator. IUCN Red List; Ceballos et al.
Climate_Rationale: Extinction tallies compiled from IUCN records; climate change increasingly identified as a threat in assessments but historical extinctions are dominated by land-use and overexploitation.

Units_Measure: Predicted species richness per grid cell from Area-based Impact Model (AIM)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). AIM model – Newbold et al. 2015.
Climate_Rationale: AIM predicts richness from land use and climate; climate used as environmental covariate; projected impacts include climate-change component.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1; 1 = no extinction risk); all assessed taxa
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: GBF Goal A headline indicator (A.3). Official indicator for SDG 15.5.1. Informs CBD COP monitoring and IPBES status assessments.
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. IUCN Red List; Butchart et al.
Climate_Rationale: Climate change is a recognised and growing threat driver in IUCN assessments; RLI values reflect climate-driven status changes for coral, amphibian and alpine taxa.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1); forest-dependent bird, amphibian and mammal species
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. IUCN; BirdLife.
Climate_Rationale: Forest specialist RLI reflects deforestation as primary driver; climate change exacerbates via fire and drought-induced forest dieback.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1); bird species involved in international trade
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. IUCN; BirdLife; CITES.
Climate_Rationale: Internationally traded bird RLI primarily reflects overexploitation and habitat loss; climate is a secondary driver.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1); wild pollinator species (bees, hoverflies, moths, butterflies)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. IUCN; IPBES Pollination Assessment.
Climate_Rationale: Climate change causes phenological mismatches and range shifts for pollinators; heat stress reduces pollinator foraging activity; medium climate dependency.

Indicator_Name: RLI – species used in food and medicine
Units_Measure: Index (0–1); bird, mammal and amphibian species used in food or medicine
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. IUCN; Scharlemann et al.
Climate_Rationale: Climate change affects wild food and medicinal species through habitat shifts, phenological mismatches and altered fire regimes.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1); wild relatives of domesticated food plant and animal species
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. IUCN; FAO crop wild relatives.
Climate_Rationale: Wild relatives face climate-driven range contractions; their loss reduces adaptive potential of food crops under future climates – ecologically and economically significant.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1); proportion of species estimated to persist given habitat loss
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. CSIRO; Williams et al.
Climate_Rationale: BHI-species uses land-use-derived habitat persistence models; climate is a background factor modulating SDMs but land use dominates the index.

Units_Measure: Index (0–1); disaggregated to biodiversity hotspots
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator – hotspot disaggregation.
Climate_Rationale: As N-061; disaggregated to biodiversity hotspots.

Units_Measure: % of species with ≥80% suitable habitat remaining; mammal-specific
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Species distribution models – mammals.
Climate_Rationale: SDMs for mammals incorporate climate variables (temperature, precipitation) as primary predictor layers; climate-change scenarios alter projected habitat suitability.

Units_Measure: Projected global bird species richness from cSAR model
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). cSAR global bird richness. Martins & Pereira.
Climate_Rationale: cSAR uses habitat extent from land-cover data; range maps incorporate climate via SDMs; future projections include climate-change scenarios.

Units_Measure: Projected forest-specialist bird species richness from cSAR model
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). cSAR – forest specialist birds.
Climate_Rationale: As N-064; disaggregated to forest specialist birds; forest loss driven by land use and increasingly by climate-induced disturbance.

Units_Measure: Mean geographic range area (km²) across mammal species; trend
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). IUCN range maps; IUCN Red List.
Climate_Rationale: Mammalian ranges assessed from IUCN maps which incorporate both habitat loss and climate-driven range shifts; climate change is a recognised driver of range contraction.

Units_Measure: Mean geographic range area (km²) for megafaunal species (body mass >100 kg)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). IUCN megafauna range maps.
Climate_Rationale: Megafauna range loss dominated by land-use change and hunting; climate is a secondary factor in range contraction.

Units_Measure: Index of change in habitat-based species persistence (0–1; baseline ~2000)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Core indicator for GBF Goal A and Target 2 (restore degraded ecosystems). SDG 15.5 (halt biodiversity loss). Informs IPBES GA and CBD monitoring framework.
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. UNEP-WCMC/NatureServe/Map of Life.
Climate_Rationale: Species habitat modelled from land-cover change; climate is a background driver of habitat suitability modulating SDM inputs; projected impacts include climate-change scenario components.

Units_Measure: % of assessed marine fish stocks within biologically sustainable levels (SDG 14.4.1)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species). Official SDG 14.4.1 indicator. Core indicator in IPBES GA. Informs CBD monitoring.
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. FAO Fisheries; ICES; WCPFC.
Climate_Rationale: Ocean warming alters fish stock productivity, recruitment and distribution; stock reference points embedded in the indicator are derived partly from climate-sensitive models.

Units_Measure: Index (1970 = 1); monitored vertebrate population trends
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: GBF Goal A headline indicator. Highlighted indicator in IPBES GA. SDG 15.5. Informs WWF Living Planet Report and CBD biodiversity monitoring.
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Highlighted indicator. ZSL / WWF LPI database.
Climate_Rationale: Climate change is embedded as a threat driver in LPI calculations; weather affects detectability in many survey protocols; substantial climate contribution to population declines for climate-sensitive taxa.

Units_Measure: Index (1970 = 1); freshwater vertebrate populations
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). ZSL/WWF LPI – freshwater disaggregation.
Climate_Rationale: Freshwater LPI reflects hydrological changes (drought, altered flow regimes) strongly linked to climate; freshwater vertebrates among most climate-sensitive groups.

Units_Measure: Index (1970 = 1); marine vertebrate populations
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). ZSL/WWF LPI – marine disaggregation.
Climate_Rationale: Marine LPI strongly affected by ocean warming and acidification impacting fish, seabirds and marine mammals.

Units_Measure: Index (1970 = 1); terrestrial vertebrate populations
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). ZSL/WWF LPI – terrestrial disaggregation.
Climate_Rationale: Terrestrial LPI driven primarily by land use; climate contributes to population declines through drought, extreme heat and altered seasonality.

Units_Measure: Biomass index of large (>100 g) predatory fish (kg/ha); trend
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Sea Around Us / SEAPODYM models.
Climate_Rationale: Predatory fish biomass affected by ocean warming through prey availability and thermal habitat shifts; fishing pressure is the dominant driver but climate modulates productivity.

Units_Measure: Biomass index of small prey fish (forage fish; kg/ha); trend
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Sea Around Us / SEAPODYM.
Climate_Rationale: Forage fish biomass highly sensitive to ocean temperature and stratification through effects on plankton productivity; strong ENSO-driven variability.

Units_Measure: Index (baseline year = 100); habitat-specialist bird species
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). PECBMS; BirdLife International.
Climate_Rationale: Habitat-specialist bird indices derived from national breeding bird surveys where weather directly affects detectability and breeding success; spring temperature is a key confounding variable.

Units_Measure: Total wild terrestrial mammal biomass (GtC); trend
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Bar-On et al. 2018; synthesis.
Climate_Rationale: Wild mammal biomass dominated by a few large herbivore and carnivore groups; estimated from species mass and abundance data; climate is an indirect driver operating through land-use change.

Units_Measure: Functional richness index from Madingley model output
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Madingley model; Harfoot et al.
Climate_Rationale: Madingley uses NPP and temperature as inputs affecting body size, metabolic rates and food web structure; climate change alters modelled functional diversity through these pathways.

Units_Measure: Mean body mass (kg) across mammal assemblages; trend
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Goal A (biodiversity status and trends) and GBF monitoring framework headline indicators. Informs IPBES Global Assessment chapters on status and trends of nature for SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 14 (Life Below Water).
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). IUCN; PanTHERIA; Jones et al.
Climate_Rationale: Mammalian body mass trends primarily reflect selective defaunation (larger species hunted preferentially); climate-induced body size reductions (Bergmann's rule) are a secondary emerging signal.

Units_Measure: Mean trophic level of global marine fish landings (dimensionless)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species). Core indicator in IPBES GA. Relevant to SDG 14.4 (end overfishing). Informs IPBES and FAO assessment of marine ecosystem health.
Source_Reference: IPBES Global Assessment (2019); GA Supplementary Materials – Table 1 (Ch 2.2). Core indicator. FAO FishStat; Pauly & Watson 2005.
Climate_Rationale: Ocean warming alters fish community trophic structure by shifting species distributions; high-latitude warming enables range expansion of lower-trophic species; fishing pressure is the primary driver.

Units_Measure: Proxy: Biodiversity Intactness Index; ecoregion habitat extent (% baseline)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 1 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 1.3.4. Newbold et al. 2016; Dinerstein et al. 2017.
Climate_Rationale: Habitat creation and maintenance underpinned by ecosystem processes; climate change modifies habitat turnover rates but this proxy (BII/extent) is primarily land-use driven.

Indicator_Name: NCP 2: Pollination and dispersal of seeds and other propagules
Units_Measure: Proxy: RLI (pollinators); wild pollinator abundance indices
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions – pollination) and GBF Target 4 (pollinator species recovery). SDG 2.4 (sustainable food production). Informs IPBES NCP assessment and IPBES Pollination Assessment.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 2.3.4. IPBES Pollination Assessment 2016; Ricketts et al. 2008.
Climate_Rationale: Pollination services affected by climate change through phenological mismatches between flowering plants and pollinators; heat stress reduces pollinator foraging efficiency.

Units_Measure: Proxy: Vegetation cover (LAI, NDVI); air pollutant deposition rates
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 3 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 3.3.4. FAO/MODIS; EMEP.
Climate_Rationale: Vegetation-regulated air quality (dry deposition, aerosol capture) is modulated by LAI, which is climate-sensitive; drought-induced vegetation die-back reduces air quality regulation capacity.

Units_Measure: Proxy: Net land-atmosphere carbon flux; extent of carbon-dense ecosystems (GtC/yr)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature-based climate regulation) and GBF Target 8 (climate-biodiversity nexus). SDG 13.1 (climate resilience). Informs IPBES GA climate regulation NCP.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 4.3.4. IPCC AR6; Global Carbon Project.
Climate_Rationale: Climate regulation by ecosystems is directly tied to climate change; warming reduces carbon sink capacity through increased heterotrophic respiration and fire; this NCP proxy uses climate data as both driver and output.

Units_Measure: Proxy: Phytoplankton biomass; ocean alkalinity (pH units and buffering capacity)
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 8 (climate change impacts – ocean acidification) and GBF Target 11 (marine ecosystem services). SDG 14.3 (minimize ocean acidification). Informs IPBES GA ocean NCP.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 5.3.4. Global Ocean Acidification Observing Network.
Climate_Rationale: Ocean acidification is a direct consequence of atmospheric CO₂ increase; marine biological buffering capacity is itself affected by warming; climate data (CO₂, SST) are the primary inputs.

Indicator_Name: NCP 6: Regulation of freshwater quantity, timing and location
Units_Measure: Proxy: Vegetation water yield and regulation; streamflow variability indices
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (freshwater ecosystem services). SDG 6.6 (protect water-related ecosystems). Informs IPBES GA freshwater regulation NCP.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 6.3.4. SWAT/VIC hydrological models; GRDC.
Climate_Rationale: Freshwater regulation is directly affected by precipitation patterns, snowmelt timing and evapotranspiration – all strongly climate-driven; vegetation cover modulates these hydrological fluxes.

Indicator_Name: NCP 7: Regulation of freshwater and coastal water quality
Units_Measure: Proxy: Riparian vegetation cover; nutrient retention efficiency of wetlands
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 7 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 7.3.4. UN GEMS/Water; Ramsar.
Climate_Rationale: Freshwater quality regulation by riparian vegetation is affected by drought (reducing dilution) and heavy rainfall (increasing nutrient runoff); climate change alters the capacity of vegetation to buffer pollution.

Indicator_Name: NCP 8: Formation, protection and decontamination of soils and sediments
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Water | Land Use & Agriculture
Units_Measure: Proxy: Soil organic carbon; RUSLE erosion index; riparian buffer coverage
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 8 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 8.3.4. ISRIC; FAO GAEZ.
Climate_Rationale: Soil formation and protection by vegetation is sensitive to extreme rainfall (erosion risk) and drought (vegetation loss exposing soil); climate change increases erosion risk and reduces SOC inputs.

Indicator_Name: NCP 9: Regulation of hazards and extreme events
Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Marine & Fisheries | Land Use & Agriculture
Units_Measure: Proxy: Extent of coastal vegetation (mangroves, saltmarsh, reefs); floodplain forest cover
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (coastal and hazard regulation NCPs) and GBF Target 8 (climate adaptation). SDG 13.1 (resilience to climate hazards). Informs IPBES GA coastal protection NCP.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 9.3.4. InVEST coastal protection models; IPCC AR6.
Climate_Rationale: Coastal habitat extent determines flood and storm protection services; climate change increases storm intensity and sea-level rise, simultaneously increasing demand for and reducing supply of these services.

Indicator_Name: NCP 10: Regulation of organisms detrimental to humans
Units_Measure: Proxy: Predator/parasitoid biodiversity; vector control by birds and bats
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 10 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 10.3.4. Various epidemiological datasets.
Climate_Rationale: Climate change expands habitat for disease vectors; changing predator communities under warming alter pest regulation capacity; temperature-dependent vector reproduction increases disease burden.

Units_Measure: Proxy: Biomass energy supply (EJ/yr); fuelwood consumption per capita
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 11 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 11.3.4. FAO/IEA fuelwood data.
Climate_Rationale: Biomass energy supply from ecosystems primarily determined by forest extent and growth rates; climate affects productivity but the proxy is primarily an economic and governance metric.

Policy_Sector: Nature & Biodiversity | Marine & Fisheries | Land Use & Agriculture
Units_Measure: Proxy: Wild-sourced protein (fish, bushmeat, wild plants) as % of dietary protein; fisheries landings
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 5 (sustainable use of wild species for food) and GBF Target 11. SDG 2.1 (food security); SDG 14.4 (sustainable fisheries). Informs IPBES GA food and feed NCP.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 12.3.4. FAO FishStat; FAOSTAT; RLI for food/medicine species.
Climate_Rationale: Wild food supply from marine fisheries is strongly affected by climate-driven changes in ocean productivity and stock distribution; terrestrial wild food less directly affected but drought reduces availability.

Units_Measure: Proxy: Timber and fibre production (Mm³/yr); extent of sustainably managed forests
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 13 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 13.3.4. FAO FRA; FSC/PEFC.
Climate_Rationale: Materials supply from ecosystems tracked by timber production data; climate affects tree growth rates and timber quality but the proxy is primarily a governance and land-use metric.

Units_Measure: Proxy: RLI (species used for food and medicine); number of plant-derived medicines
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 14 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 14.3.4. IUCN; FAO; WHO.
Climate_Rationale: Species providing medicinal resources are threatened by climate-driven range shifts and habitat loss; distribution of medicinal plants shifting under warming.

Units_Measure: Proxy: Biodiversity Intactness Index; number of species studied per scientific publication
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 15 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 15.3.4. BII; Web of Science bibliometrics.
Climate_Rationale: Learning and inspiration NCP proxied by biodiversity intactness and scientific output; not directly climate-dependent in measurement.

Units_Measure: Proxy: Tourism in natural areas; access to green/blue space
Policy_Goal: Kunming-Montreal GBF: Relevant to GBF Target 11 (nature's contributions to people – NCPs) and GBF Goal B (ecosystem services to people). Informs SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) via IPBES NCP assessment. IPBES NCP 16 proxy indicator.
Source_Reference: GA Ch 2.3 Supp, Section 16.3.4. UNWTO; Protected Planet visitor data.
Climate_Rationale: Extreme weather and climate-driven habitat change can reduce amenity value of natural areas; temperature affects outdoor recreation suitability seasonally.
